Subject: Guêpe Cristalline. A dangerous hovering crystal wasp insect with an emerald-green articulated metallic thorax, dark green segmented abdomen, four sharply faceted pale-green crystal wings with solid opaque emerald edges and only small transparent internal highlights, rose-red crystalline stinger, delicate gold antennae and glowing amber pollen lights. No human features. Attack abdomen curls for a stinger thrust and wings sweep strongly. Death wings fracture into green crystal petals and gold pollen motes.
Color palette: Deep emerald #064e3b, luminous sap green #34d399, rose crystal #e11d48, gold pollen #fbbf24.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset for Infernal City: ONE new enemy animation PNG atlas, wide 2:1 composition, target 2048 x 1024, genuine transparent RGBA background.
FIRST VISUAL DESIGN of a named Flora enemy; no earlier individual sprite identity exists. Use references only for the established painterly dark botanical sci-fi style, emerald wrought iron, rose crystal and gold pollen materials, crisp 3/4 game-view camera. Do not copy reference structures or their atlas layout.
EXACTLY 8 equally spaced columns and 4 equally spaced rows = 32 individually drawn distinct animation poses. Invisible regular cell grid, no visible lines or labels. Each whole subject, including all limbs/wings, petals, weapon effects, fragments and shield pieces, is SMALL: fit within the central 45-50 percent of its cell WIDTH AND HEIGHT. Keep at least 25 percent fully empty transparent padding on EACH of all four edges of EVERY cell. This generous spacing is mandatory. Same camera, lower-right-facing orientation, scale and fixed pivot centred in each cell throughout; no camera rotations or zoom. The rows align perfectly and cells do not overlap.
BODY OPACITY IS MANDATORY: the creature's painted metal/plant surfaces are solid opaque alpha 255, visibly dense and saturated. Only isolated edge antialiasing and a few crystal highlights may be partially transparent. Every empty background pixel must have alpha 0, not near-transparent gray. No gray wash over the atlas. NO haze, mist, fog, glow carpet, diffuse bloom, translucent body, floor, grounding oval, drop shadow, scenery, checkerboard, colored/white/black background or vignette. The body and compact effects are clean separate cutouts surrounded by true empty alpha.
Row 1 MOVE: eight distinct phases of a readable locomotion or wingbeat cycle, changing limbs and appendages without changing identity; phase 8 adjacent to phase 1, not a duplicate.
Row 2 ATTACK: eight distinct phases, idle preparation, anticipation, wind-up, release, contact/emission, recoil, recovery, ready. Compact attack FX stay inside the central half-cell.
Row 3 DEATH_DISSOLVE: eight distinct sequential stages from struck intact creature through bending/collapse, fragmentation and dissolution to just a few visible fragments in the last cell. No blood or gore. Small opaque shards rather than translucent fog.
Row 4 SHIELD_BREAK: eight distinct recoil/recovery stages with a thin small faction-colored shield shell cracking and breaking into a FEW compact shards, then a clearly recovered intact creature. Shield does not obscure the body or exceed central half-cell.
No text, logos, labels, numbers, symbols outside the creature, watermarks, cell frames or extra subjects. Preserve the exact same newly established creature design across all 32 cells.
Subject: Rampeur de Lierre. A low sinuous ivy crawler with a compact armored emerald iron seedpod body, six short interwoven vine legs, a small faceted rose-crystal head, broad dark-green leaves along the back and tiny golden thorns. Clear crawling plant-creature silhouette. Attack lunges and lashes a short ivy tendril contained inside the cell. Death vine legs curl and body dissolves into leaves, green sap motes and gold pollen.
Color palette: Deep emerald #064e3b, luminous sap green #34d399, rose crystal #e11d48, gold pollen #fbbf24.
